title: The cluster manager: who gets to decide which node is the primary

videos.script: Two servers that cannot reach each other cannot decide which of them is the primary. A third party has to. {{third}} You build three PostgreSQL nodes run by Patroni, and an etcd that holds one key: the name of the leader. {{key}} You kill the leader as a dead machine would. Nothing happens for half a minute, and then another node takes the key and promotes itself. {{failover}} The dead node comes back, and this time it rejoins as a replica, rewound on its own. {{rejoin}} A switchover is one command. {{switch}} Then you stop etcd, and the primary, perfectly healthy, makes itself read-only. {{etcd}}
